plugins.description: Universal engineering standards for Claude Code — auto-detects your project (or bootstraps an empty one), adapts rules, and enforces architecture layering, size limits, DRY, security, and clean code. Hooks block oversized writes and hardcoded secrets; includes CI enforcement (GitHub Actions, pre-commit, PR templates).
